summary: Candidate sources identified for professional taxonomy and facility affiliation. CMS search results describe the facility affiliation dataset and its fields, but the official dataset page returned only a JavaScript shell when opened, so dataset/API URLs and rights terms could not be independently verified here. Treat these as discovery leads; no records were acquired and no join coverage was calculated.

sources.title: Facility Affiliation Data
sources.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Provider Data Catalog
sources.geography: United States; filter to CCN 310038 and 310070 for this study
sources.period: Search result reported last modified June 26, 2026 and release July 9, 2026; opened page did not expose release metadata
sources.grain: NPI × facility affiliation record; CMS description includes facility type and facility CCN, and a separate primary-hospital CCN field
observed_facts: CMS search result described 2,260,193 rows and a downloadable CSV, but these details were not inspectable on the opened page.
CMS search result and its indexed field description identify NPI, PAC ID, provider names, facility type, affiliation CCN, and primary-hospital CCN.
sources.retrieval_next_step: In an independently verified CMS catalog session, capture the current release metadata, data dictionary, download/API URL, and rights statement. Filter records to CCNs 310038 and 310070; deduplicate NPIs in a stable order and select the first 100. Join those NPIs to NPPES on NPI only, retain NPI and professional taxonomy fields, and report matched/queried counts plus registry retrieval/update date. Do not infer privileges or shifts.
limitations: The opened CMS dataset page rendered only a JavaScript requirement; direct download/API URL and licensing evidence were not verified.
Affiliation is CMS-reported and does not establish hospital privileges, employment, or shifts.
No acquisition or match-coverage calculation was performed.

sources.title: National Downloadable File (Doctors and Clinicians)
sources.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Provider Data Catalog
sources.geography: United States; potential supplemental records for New Brunswick, New Jersey practitioners
sources.period: Search result identified a current catalog listing but its precise release period was not inspectable on the opened page
sources.grain: Clinician × Medicare enrollment record × practice location/group record
observed_facts: CMS search result says clinicians with multiple enrollment records or practice locations can appear on multiple lines.
The indexed field listing includes NPI, specialty, facility and practice-location fields.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Verify the current downloadable file, data dictionary, release date, and rights statement in the CMS catalog. As a supplemental bounded slice, filter to New Brunswick, NJ and retain NPI, specialty, facility/group identifiers, and relevant locality fields; deduplicate by NPI for comparison with the two CCN affiliation sets.
limitations: This is a Medicare enrollment/practice-location view, not a complete roster of local practitioners or proof of hospital affiliation.
The opened dataset page did not expose download/API details or terms.

sources.title: NPPES NPI Registry API and public registry
sources.geography: United States; query selected NPIs affiliated with CCN 310038 or 310070
sources.period: Registry records are queried live; preserve the returned last-updated date per record where provided
observed_facts: The official registry search result says public records include provider name, specialty/taxonomy and practice address, and that data are available through a full download or API.
The API page opened with no inspectable content in this task, so request syntax, fields, limits, and terms were not verified.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Use the official API documentation to verify request syntax and limits, then query the deterministic first 100 unique affiliation NPIs individually or in documented bounded batches. Retain only NPI, taxonomy assertions and registry update/enumeration dates needed for the join; omit address and contact details.
limitations: API endpoint parameters and direct request URL were not verified from the opened page.
NPPES taxonomy is a registry assertion and does not establish current clinical practice, privileges, or shifts.

missing_inputs: Current inspectable CMS facility-affiliation download/API URL and data dictionary
Verified data-use/redistribution terms for the proposed CMS and NPPES extracts
A deterministic first-100 NPI slice and resulting NPPES match coverage
simulation_use: If independently verified, combine CMS affiliation records filtered to CCN 310038 and 310070 with minimized NPPES taxonomy assertions using NPI as the sole join key. Keep affiliation and taxonomy as separate evidence-backed attributes, preserve each source's release/update dates, and label them as registry/reporting evidence rather than privileges, schedules, or local staffing levels.
limitations: This is candidate research, not independent verification or dataset acquisition.
Only two searches and four page opens were used; the pages either rendered a JavaScript shell or exposed no text.
No New Brunswick or Middlesex County practitioner estimate was derived.
